judgement.reason: Authentik is a single-image web app backed by PostgreSQL, and media storage can be moved to S3, so DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is not too lenient.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./data:/data (lifecycle/container/compose.yml server), volume ./custom-templates:/templates (lifecycle/container/compose.yml server), volume ./data:/data (lifecycle/container/compose.yml worker), volume ./custom-templates:/templates (lifecycle/container/compose.yml worker)
reviews.reason: The shown files do not prove that the /data volume (media and uploaded files) or the custom templates are moved to S3 or are otherwise not needed in production, so the vendor should confirm whether these directories hold durable state.
